Poem of Gilgameš – Standard Babylonian IV: “[At Twenty] Leagues They Broke Bread”

  • Source: eBL corpus – https://www.ebl.lmu.de/corpus/L/1/4/Standard%20Babylonian/IV
  • API: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/api/texts/L/1/4/chapters/Standard%20Babylonian/IV/display
  • Edition: Andrew R. George (editor); Geraldina Rozzi (revision); Enrique Jiménez (revision)
  • Translation: Andrew R. George
  • Generated by tools/ebl_fetch.py on 2026-10-17 – do not edit by hand; re-run the tool instead.

Per line: N = normalized Akkadian reconstruction (| metrical foot, || caesura); T = eBL English translation; L = lemmas with eBL dictionary glosses; then notes, parallel lines, and the manuscripts' transliterations (ATF). Bibliography keys like [RN117: 889] are resolved in bibliography.md (RN117 = George 2003).

1

  • N: [ana ešrā] (|) bēr || iksupū | kusāpa
  • T: [At twenty] leagues they broke bread,
  • L: [ana ← ana I “(aš-š... etc.) to, for (freq. abbr. an, with assimilation of n…”; ešrā] ← ešrā I “twenty”; bēr ← bēru III “double hour, league”; iksupū ← kasāpu I “to break (into bits) O/jB, M/NA”; kusāpa ← kusāpu I
  • Parallels: L I.4 SB "IV" 34; L I.4 SB "IV" 79; L I.4 SB "IV" 120; L I.4 SB "IV" 163
UrkNB1a i 1. [a-na 20] DANNA ik-su-pu ku-sa-a-pu

2

  • N: [ana šala]šā (|) bēr || iškunū | nubatta
  • T: [at] thirty leagues they pitched camp.
  • L: [ana ← ana I “(aš-š... etc.) to, for (freq. abbr. an, with assimilation of n…”; šala]šā ← šalāšā I “thirty”; bēr ← bēru III “double hour, league”; iškunū ← šakānu I “to put, place, lay down”; nubatta ← nubattu I “evening (rest) Bab., M/NA”
  • Parallels: L I.4 SB "IV" 35; L I.4 SB "IV" 80; L I.4 SB "IV" 121; L I.4 SB "IV" 164
UrkNB1a i 2. [a-na 3]0 DANNA iš-ku-nu nu-bat-tu₄

3

  • N: [hanšā (|) b]ēr || illikū | kal ūmi
  • T: [Fifty] leagues they travelled in the course of a day,
  • L: [hanšā ← hamšā I “fifty st. abs.”; b]ēr ← bēru III “double hour, league”; illikū ← alāku I “to go”; kal ← kalû II “all, totality”; ūmi ← ūmu I “pl. m. & f. day”
  • Parallels: L I.4 SB "IV" 36; L I.4 SB "IV" 81; L I.4 SB "IV" 122; L I.4 SB "IV" 165
UrkNB1a i 3. [50 D]ANNA!(KASKAL) il-li-ku kal u₄-mu

4

  • N: [mālak (|) arh]i (|) u šapatti | ina šalši (|) ūmi | iṭhû | ana šadî (|) labnānu
  • T: a month and a half’s [march] by the third day, they drew near to Mount Lebanon.
  • L: [mālak ← mālaku I “walk, way”; arh]i ← warhu I “”; u ← u I “and, but, also”; šapatti ← šapattu I “15th day of month OAkk, Bab., OA”; ina ← ina I “(im-m..., ip-p... etc.) in, on”; šalši ← šalšu I “f. šalištum, šaluštu(m), šalultu, NA šalussu, MB also…”; ūmi ← ūmu I “pl. m. & f. day”; iṭhû ← ṭehû I “to be(come) near to, approach”; ana ← ana I “(aš-š... etc.) to, for (freq. abbr. an, with assimilation of n…”; šadî ← šadû I “st. constr. šad(i)”; labnānu ← labnu I “f. labittu (spread) flat MA, jB of face, nose”
  • Parallels: cf. L I.4 OB "Schøyen₂" 25-26; L I.4 SB "IV" 37; L I.4 SB "IV" 82; L I.4 SB "IV" 123-124

5

  • N: [ana pān (|) šamaš || uha]rrû | [būra]
  • T: [Facing the sun they] dug [a well,]
  • L: [ana ← ana I “(aš-š... etc.) to, for (freq. abbr. an, with assimilation of n…”; pān ← pānu I “front, pl. face”; šamaš ← Šamaš I; uha]rrû ← harāru I “to dig, hollow out O/jB”; [būra] ← būru I “cistern, well”
  • Parallels: L I.4 SB "IV" 38; L I.4 SB "IV" 83; L I.4 SB "IV" 125; L I.4 SB "IV" 166
UrkNB1a i 5. [a-na IGI {d}UTU u₂-ha]r-ru-u₂ [bu-u₂-ru]

6

  • N: [mê? | ... | iškunū | ina ... ]
  • T: [in their waterskins they put fresh water]
  • L: [mê? ← mû I “pl. tant. water mê kabrūtim mass of water”; iškunū ← šakānu I “to put, place, lay down”; ina ← ina I “(im-m..., ip-p... etc.) in, on”
  • Parallels: L I.4 SB "IV" 39; L I.4 SB "IV" 84; L I.4 SB "IV" 126; L I.4 SB "IV" 167

7

  • N: [īlī-ma | gilgāmeš || ina muhhi | šadî]
  • T: [Gilgamesh went up on to the top of the mountain,]
  • L: [īlī-ma ← elû III “to go up, arise”; gilgāmeš ← Gilgameš I; ina ← ina I “(im-m..., ip-p... etc.) in, on”; muhhi ← muhhu I “skull”; šadî] ← šadû I “st. constr. šad(i)”
  • Parallels: cf. L I.4 OB "Schøyen₂" 27; L I.4 SB "IV" 40; L I.4 SB "IV" 85; L I.4 SB "IV" 127; L I.4 SB "IV" 168

8

  • N: [maṣhassu | utteqqâ | ana hursāni]
  • T: [he made his offerings of *maṣḫatu-*flour to the hill.]
  • L: [maṣhassu ← maṣhatu I “(a kind of flour) Bab., M/NA”; utteqqâ ← naqû I “to pour (a libation), sacrifice”; ana ← ana I “(aš-š... etc.) to, for (freq. abbr. an, with assimilation of n…”; hursāni] ← huršānu I “mountain(s) M/NB often pl.”
  • Parallels: L I.4 SB "IV" 41; L I.4 SB "IV" 86; L I.4 SB "IV" 128; L I.4 SB "IV" 169

9

  • N: [šadû | bila | šutta | amāt (|) šamši | damiqta | lūmur]
  • T: ‘[O mountain, bring me a dream, let me see a favourable message from Šamaš!]’
  • L: [šadû ← šadû I “st. constr. šad(i)”; bila ← wabālu I “(cf. also babālu) to carry, bring”; šutta ← šuttu I “pl. šunātu(m) dream š. naṭālu, amāru etc. to have a dream, to…”; amāt ← awātu I “word”; šamši ← šamšu I “OB occas. f. sun”; damiqta ← damqu I “good”; lūmur] ← amāru I “to see”
  • Parallels: L I.4 SB "IV" 42; L I.4 SB "IV" 87; L I.4 SB "IV" 129; L I.4 SB "IV" 170; cf. F BM.32885 r 6

10

  • N: [īpušaššum-ma | enkīdu || ana šâšu | bīt zaqīqi]
  • T: [Enkidu made for him a ‘house of Zaqīqu’,]
  • L: [īpušaššum-ma ← epēšu II “to do”; enkīdu ← Enkidu I; ana ← ana I “(aš-š... etc.) to, for (freq. abbr. an, with assimilation of n…”; šâšu ← šâšu I “(to/of) him Bab., NA”; bīt ← bītu I “m.”; zaqīqi] ← zīqīqu I “wind, breeze Bab.”
  • Parallels: L I.4 SB "IV" 43; L I.4 SB "IV" 88; L I.4 SB "IV" 130; L I.4 SB "IV" 171

11

  • N: [dalat (|) šarbilli || irteti | ina bābīšu]
  • T: [he fixed a storm-door in its doorway.]
  • L: [dalat ← daltu I “f. door d. šamê/erṣeti cosmic door of heaven/underworld”; šarbilli ← šarbillu I “storm jB”; irteti ← retû II “to drive in, fix Bab., NA”; ina ← ina I “(im-m..., ip-p... etc.) in, on”; bābīšu] ← bābu I “pl. m. & f. gate, door”
  • Parallels: L I.4 SB "IV" 44; L I.4 SB "IV" 89; L I.4 SB "IV" 131; L I.4 SB "IV" 172

12

  • N: [ušnīlšū-ma | ina kippati ... (|) uṣurti]
  • T: [in the circle he had drawn he made him lie down,]
  • L: [ušnīlšū-ma ← nâlu I “to lie down (to sleep)”; ina ← ina I “(im-m..., ip-p... etc.) in, on”; kippati ← kippatu I “circle, hoop, ring Bab., M/NA”; uṣurti] ← uṣurtu I “drawing, plan Bab., NA”
  • Parallels: L I.4 SB "IV" 45; L I.4 SB "IV" 90; L I.4 SB "IV" 132; L I.4 SB "IV" 173

13

  • N: [u šū | kīma šēšê (|) ... (|) ittatīl | ina bābīšu]
  • T: [and falling flat like a net lay himself in the doorway]
  • L: [u ← u I “and, but, also”; šū ← šū I “he”; kīma ← kīma I “like”; šēšê ← šēšû I “(a small net) O/jB”; ittatīl ← nâlu I “to lie down (to sleep)”; ina ← ina I “(im-m..., ip-p... etc.) in, on”; bābīšu] ← bābu I “pl. m. & f. gate, door”
  • Parallels: L I.4 SB "IV" 46; L I.4 SB "IV" 91; L I.4 SB "IV" 133; L I.4 SB "IV" 174

14

  • N: [gilgāmeš | ina kinṣīšu || ūtammeda | zuqassu]
  • T: [Gilgamesh rested his chin on his knees,]
  • L: [gilgāmeš ← Gilgameš I; ina ← ina I “(im-m..., ip-p... etc.) in, on”; kinṣīšu ← kimṣu I “shin, lower leg Bab., NA”; ūtammeda ← emēdu I “to lean on”; zuqassu] ← suqtu I “f. chin O/jB of person, Mari s. lapātum touch s.o.'s chin (a…”
  • Parallels: L I.4 OB "Schøyen₂" 29; L I.4 SB "IV" 47; L I.4 SB "IV" 92; L I.4 SB "IV" 134; L I.4 SB "IV" 175

15

  • N: [šittu | rēhât (|) nišī || elīšu | imqut]
  • T: [the sleep that spills over people fell upon him.]
  • L: [šittu ← šittu I “sleep Bab. good, bad”; rēhât ← rehû I “to pour out”; nišī ← nišu I “mostly pl. nišū”; elīšu ← eli I “on, over, above”; imqut] ← maqātu I “to fall”
  • Parallels: L I.4 OB "Schøyen₂" 30; cf. L I.4 MB "Boğ₂" 6'; L I.4 SB "IV" 48; L I.4 SB "IV" 93; L I.4 SB "IV" 135; L I.4 SB "IV" 176

16

  • N: [ina qablīti | šittašu | uqatti]
  • T: [In the middle watch (of the night) he reached his sleep’s end,]
  • L: [ina ← ina I “(im-m..., ip-p... etc.) in, on”; qablīti ← qablītu I “centre, central part”; šittašu ← šittu I “sleep Bab. good, bad”; uqatti] ← qatû II “to come to an end, finish OAkk, Bab.”
  • Parallels: cf. L I.4 OB "Schøyen₂" 2; L I.4 OB "Schøyen₂" 31; cf. L I.4 MB "Boğ₂" 7'; L I.4 SB "IV" 49; L I.4 SB "IV" 94; L I.4 SB "IV" 136; L I.4 SB "IV" 177

17

  • N: [itbē-ma | ītammâ | ana ibrīšu]
  • T: [he arose to talk to his friend:]
  • L: [itbē-ma ← tebû I “OAkk, Ass. tabā'u(m), NB tabû to get up, arise, set out”; ītammâ ← awû I “to speak”; ana ← ana I “(aš-š... etc.) to, for (freq. abbr. an, with assimilation of n…”; ibrīšu] ← ibru I “friend, colleague”
  • Parallels: L I.4 OB "Schøyen₂" 3; L I.4 OB "Schøyen₂" 32; cf. L I.4 OB "Schøyen₃" g+2'; cf. L I.4 MB "Boğ₂" 7'; L I.4 SB "IV" 50; L I.4 SB "IV" 95; L I.4 SB "IV" 137; L I.4 SB "IV" 178

18

  • N: [ibrī | ul talsânni || ammīni | ērēku]
  • T: ‘[My friend, did you not call me? Why am I awake?]
  • L: [ibrī ← ibru I “friend, colleague”; ul ← ul I “not Bab., to negate main clause”; talsânni ← šasû I “to shout, call (out)”; ammīni ← ammīni I “why?”; ērēku] ← êru I “to be(come) awake”
  • Parallels: cf. L I.4 OB "Schøyen₂" 4b; cf. L I.4 MB "Boǧ₂" 9'; L I.4 SB "IV" 51; L I.4 SB "IV" 96; L I.4 SB "IV" 138; L I.4 SB "IV" 179

19

  • N: [ul talputanni | ammīni | šāšâku]
  • T: [Did you not touch me? Why am I in confusion?]
  • L: [ul ← ul I “not Bab., to negate main clause”; talputanni ← lapātu I “to touch, take hold of”; ammīni ← ammīni I “why?”; šāšâku] ← šāšû I “confused, disturbed”
  • Parallels: L I.4 SB "IV" 52; L I.4 SB "IV" 97; L I.4 SB "IV" 139; L I.4 SB "IV" 180

20

  • N: [ul ilu | ītiq | ammīni | hamû | šīrūʾa]
  • T: [Did a god not pass by? Why is my flesh benumbed?]
  • L: [ul ← ul I “not Bab., to negate main clause”; ilu ← ilu I “pl. ilū, ilānu god, deity a or the god, also du.”; ītiq ← etēqu I “to go past”; ammīni ← ammīni I “why?”; hamû ← hamû I “~ to paralyse jB”; šīrūʾa] ← šīru I, -a I “often pl. flesh”
  • Parallels: L I.4 SB "IV" 53; L I.4 SB "IV" 98; L I.4 SB "IV" 140; L I.4 SB "IV" 181

21

  • N: [ibrī | ātamar || ištêt | šutta]
  • T: [My friend, I have seen a dream,]
  • L: [ibrī ← ibru I “friend, colleague”; ātamar ← amāru I “to see”; ištêt ← ištēn I “f. išteat, ištiat, iš/ltē/īt(um), iš/ltât, NA issēt”; šutta] ← šuttu I “pl. šunātu(m) dream š. naṭālu, amāru etc. to have a dream, to…”
  • Parallels: cf. L I.4 OB "Schøyen₂" 4a; cf. L I.4 OB "Schøyen₂" 33a; cf. L I.4 OB "Schøyen₂" 84; cf. L I.4 OB "Harmal₁" 3a; cf. L I.4 MB "Boğ₂" 8'; L I.4 SB "IV" 54; L I.4 SB "IV" 99; L I.4 SB "IV" 141; L I.4 SB "IV" 182

22

  • N: [u šu]tta | ša ām[uru || kalîš | šāšât]
  • T: [and the] dream that I saw [was completely confused.]
  • L: [u ← u I “and, but, also”; šu]tta ← šuttu I “pl. šunātu(m) dream š. naṭālu, amāru etc. to have a dream, to…”; ša ← ša I “who(m), which”; ām[uru ← amāru I “to see”; kalîš ← kalîš I “totally OAkk, Bab.”; šāšât] ← šāšû I “confused, disturbed”
  • Parallels: cf. L I.4 OB "Schøyen₂" 33b; L I.4 SB "IV" 55; L I.4 SB "IV" 100; L I.4 SB "IV" 142; L I.4 SB "IV" 183

23

  • N: [ina sa]panni (|) šadî | [ ... ]
  • T: [we were standing on] a mountain slope,
  • L: [ina ← ina I “(im-m..., ip-p... etc.) in, on”; sa]panni ← sapannu I “flatland, plain Bab., NA between mountains”; šadî ← šadû I “st. constr. šad(i)”

  • N: [šad]û | imqut | in[a ... ]
  • T: [the mountain] fell down [between us]
  • L: [šad]û ← šadû I “st. constr. šad(i)”; imqut ← maqātu I “to fall”; in[a ← ina I “(im-m..., ip-p... etc.) in, on”

25

  • N: [u nī]nu | kī ... [ ... ]
  • T: [but] we like flies [flew clean over it]
  • L: [u ← u I “and, but, also”; nī]nu ← nīnu I “we (1 pl. nom. pron.)”; kī ← kī I “like”

26

  • N: [š]a iʾʾaldam-ma | ina ṣē[ri || mitluka | ileʾʾi]
  • T: [The one who] was born in the [wild was able to give counsel,]
  • L: [š]a ← ša I “who(m), which”; iʾʾaldam-ma ← alādu I “to give birth (to)”; ina ← ina I “(im-m..., ip-p... etc.) in, on”; ṣē[ri ← ṣēru I “back, upperside”; mitluka ← mitluku I “circumspect, prudent j/NB”; ileʾʾi] ← le'û I “to be able, powerful”
  • Parallels: cf. L I.4 OB "Harmal₂" 47; cf. L I.4 OB "IM" 19; cf. L I.4 SB "IV" 107

27

  • N: [iza]kkara | ana ibrīšu | enkīdu | š[uttašu | ušamharšu]
  • T: Enkidu spoke to his friend, [making his dream meaningful to him:]
  • L: [iza]kkara ← zakāru I “to speak, say”; ana ← ana I “(aš-š... etc.) to, for (freq. abbr. an, with assimilation of n…”; ibrīšu ← ibru I “friend, colleague”; enkīdu ← Enkidu I; š[uttašu ← šuttu I “pl. šunātu(m) dream š. naṭālu, amāru etc. to have a dream, to…”; ušamharšu] ← mahāru I “to face, confront”

28

  • N: [i]brī | damqat | šuna[tka | bani | ... ]
  • T: ‘My friend, [your] dream is favourable, [ … is fine,]
  • L: [i]brī ← ibru I “friend, colleague”; damqat ← damāqu I “to be(come) good”; šuna[tka ← šuttu I “pl. šunātu(m) dream š. naṭālu, amāru etc. to have a dream, to…”; bani ← banû II “to be(come) good, beautiful Bab.”
  • Parallels: L I.4 SB "IV" 109; L I.4 SB "IV" 155

29

  • N: [š]uttu | šūqurat | [ ... ]
  • T: the dream is precious [and bodes us well]
  • L: [š]uttu ← šuttu I “pl. šunātu(m) dream š. naṭālu, amāru etc. to have a dream, to…”; šūqurat ← šūquru I “very valuable Bab. silver, stones”
NinNA1a i 8'. [š]u-ut-tu₄ šu-qu-rat [x x x x x x x]

30

  • N: [i]brī | šadû | ša tāmur[u | ... ]
  • T: My friend, the mountain that you saw [was … ,]
  • L: [i]brī ← ibru I “friend, colleague”; šadû ← šadû I “st. constr. šad(i)”; ša ← ša I “who(m), which”; tāmur[u ← amāru I “to see”
  • Parallels: cf. L I.4 OB "Schøyen₃" b+7'

31
